# METEOR STORM - D. Toon - DREAMER 18 p.4 (0080-00FF, 0200-027F: replacement page for the
# misprinted page of issue 17, see DREAMER 18 p.2) + DREAMER 17 PDF pp.34-35 "METEOR STORM (Cont)"
# (0280-067F). Printed range "( 0080 - 0700 )"; the listing ends at 067F. Needs 2K RAM.
# 0100-01FF is the display RAM (not printed, not part of the program; zero-filled here).
# load 0080-067F, run C000 (CHIP-8).
# how to play: "Your Photon-converters are damaged and can only put out enough energy to power
# either your engines or your shields." Keys 1 LEFT, 2 UP, 0 DOWN. Stop moving to put the
# shields on if you cannot dodge the meteors. Dock exactly with the Mother Ship on the left.
# Machine code: 0300-0309 (tone via CHIPOS JSR C2E5), 060C-0634 / 064C-0674 copy the screen
# pictures 0400-04FF / 0500-05FF to the display (0100).
# 0400-05FF are two full-screen pictures (crash / docked messages).
